title: Daily English source-grounded content schema
principles: Source content must not be invented.
Historical learner answers are not treated as answer keys.
Only corrections matched to the same source prompt are referenceAnswers.
Records without a validated answer key can be practised in self-assessment mode but must not be auto-marked wrong.
CEFR levels and exam alignment must not be assigned without a verified basis.

properties.historicalAttempt: Learner response recorded in the source; not automatically correct
properties.referenceAnswers: Only source-matched corrections with a target-language heuristic check; not a guarantee of all acceptable translations

dialogueRecord.turns: Ordered extracted bilingual turns; grouping still requires human review.

phrasalVerbRecord.meaning: null when not explicitly established in source
phrasalVerbRecord.usableForQuiz: true only for table entries with source-provided meaning and example

vocabularyRecord.fields: Original table headers and values preserved; normalized fields are heuristic convenience mappings.

spacedRepetition.status: engine policy, not source-derived pedagogical claim
